lines.text: Can a shape have an infinitely long edge, and still fit on your screen?
Start with a triangle. Split every side into three, and add a smaller triangle on the middle part.
Every step makes the edge four thirds longer. Repeat forever, and the edge becomes infinitely long.
But the area never grows past eight fifths of the starting triangle.
An infinite coastline around a finite island. This is the Koch snowflake.
Would you rather walk around it, or paint it?

post.title: A shape with an infinitely long edge
post.description: The Koch snowflake: every step makes the edge 4/3 longer, so it grows forever, yet the area stays under 8/5 of the first triangle. Made with code.
